units.source_text: 日色既暮，明月当空。

en.t: The day had already faded, and the bright moon hung in the sky.

units.source_text: 浮舟回想起那天晚上在对岸看到残月时的光景，眼泪流个不住，自己想想也觉得太荒唐了。

en.t: Ukifune remembered the sight of the waning moon she had seen from the opposite bank that night, and her tears would not stop; even to herself it seemed terribly foolish.

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人和乳母闲谈往事，又把住在那边的老尼姑弁君叫来共话。

en.t: The Hitachi Governor's wife chatted with the nurse about old times, and also called over the old nun Ben no Kimi, who lived nearby, to join them.

units.source_text: 弁君叙述已故大女公子的情状，说她修养功夫极深，关于应有之事，都考虑得非常周到。

en.t: Ben no Kimi spoke of the late elder princess, saying that she had been deeply cultivated and had thought through every proper matter with great care.

units.source_text: 然而眼看她青春夭逝了。

en.t: Yet they had seen her die in the bloom of youth.

units.source_text: 她说：“如果大小姐在世，定然也像二小姐一般做了高贵夫人，和你通信往还。

en.t: She said, "If the elder young lady were still alive, she too would surely have become a noble lady like the second young lady, and would have exchanged letters with you.

units.source_text: 那么你多年以来的孤苦生涯，也会变成无上幸福了。”

en.t: Then your lonely and bitter life of so many years would have turned into the greatest happiness."

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人想道：“我的浮舟和她们是亲姐妹呢。

en.t: The Hitachi Governor's wife thought, "My Ukifune is their own sister.

units.source_text: 只要宿命亨通，如意称心，将来也不会比她们逊色吧。”

en.t: If only fate opens favorably and all goes as she wishes, she need not be inferior to them in the future."

units.source_text: 对弁君说：“我为这孩子操心担忧，至今已历多年，现在方得稍稍放心。

en.t: She said to Ben no Kimi, "I have worried over this child for many years, and only now can I feel a little relieved.

units.source_text: 今后她迁居京都，我们到这里来的机会很难得了。

en.t: Once she moves to Kyoto, we will have very few chances to come here.

units.source_text: 所以我要趁今天会面的时候，大家互相谈谈旧话。”

en.t: So while we are meeting today, I want us all to talk together about old times."

units.source_text: 弁君说：“我总觉得我们出家为尼的人是不吉祥的，不应该常常来打扰小姐，所以见面之时不多。

en.t: Ben no Kimi said, "I have always felt that those of us who have become nuns are inauspicious and should not often trouble the young lady, so I have not seen her much.

units.source_text: 但现在她将舍我而乔迁京都，我倒不胜依恋之情了。

en.t: But now that she is about to leave me and move to Kyoto, I find myself overcome with attachment.

units.source_text: 然而我看这种地方毕竟荒僻不堪久居，乔迁京都真乃可喜之事。

en.t: Still, this place is, after all, too lonely and desolate for a long stay, so her move to Kyoto is truly a happy thing.

units.source_text: 况且薰大将身份之高贵、品性之敦厚，乃世间罕有。

en.t: Moreover, General Kaoru's noble rank and generous character are rare in this world.

units.source_text: 他如此热心地找寻小姐，这一片诚意实非寻常可比。

en.t: That he searched for the young lady with such devotion shows a sincerity far beyond the ordinary.

units.source_text: 我早就对你如此说过，可见我不是胡言乱道的人。”

en.t: I told you this long ago, so you can see that I am not someone who speaks nonsense."

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人道：“今后如何虽然不得而知，但现在大将的确热诚地爱她。

en.t: The Hitachi Governor's wife said, "Although we cannot know what will happen from now on, the general certainly loves her sincerely at present.

units.source_text: 这都是你老人家说合之功，我们十分感谢。

en.t: This is all thanks to your efforts in bringing them together, and we are deeply grateful.

units.source_text: 辱承匂亲王夫人垂青，我们也很感激。

en.t: We are also grateful to have received the kind regard of Prince Niou's wife.

units.source_text: 只因发生了意外之变，几乎使得她流离失所，实甚可叹。”

en.t: But because an unexpected turn of events occurred, she was almost left adrift without a place to belong; it is truly lamentable."

units.source_text: 老尼姑笑道：“这位亲王如此好色，实在令人讨厌。

en.t: The old nun laughed and said, "This prince is so amorous that he is truly unpleasant.

units.source_text: 他家几个聪明一点的青年侍女都在那里叫苦呢。

en.t: Several of the more sensible young serving women in his household are all complaining about it.

units.source_text: 大辅姐姐的女儿右近对我说：‘亲王大体上说来原是一位贤良的主人，只是这件事讨厌。

en.t: Ukon, the daughter of Taifu's elder sister, told me, 'In general, the prince is a good and worthy master; it is only this matter that is hateful.

units.source_text: 如果夫人知道了还要怪怨我们轻狂，那真是受罪了。’”

en.t: If his wife finds out and then blames us for being frivolous, that will be real suffering.'"

units.source_text: 浮舟躺着听她说，想道：“他对侍女尚且如此，何况对我。”

en.t: Ukifune lay there listening to her and thought, "If he behaves this way even toward serving women, how much more toward me."

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人说：“唉，想想有些可怕。

en.t: The Hitachi Governor's wife said, "Ah, when I think about it, it is rather frightening.

units.source_text: 薰大将已有今上的女儿为妻。

en.t: General Kaoru already has the present emperor's daughter as his wife.

units.source_text: 不过浮舟对公主关系是疏远的。

en.t: Still, Ukifune's relation to the princess is a distant one.

units.source_text: 我想，今后不论是好是坏，也只能听天由命。

en.t: I think that from now on, whether things go well or badly, we can only leave it to fate.

units.source_text: 如果再碰到匂亲王，发生不应有之事，那么我无论何等悲伤，恐怕也见不到我的浮舟了！”

en.t: If she meets Prince Niou again and something happens that should not happen, then no matter how deeply I grieve, I fear I will no longer be able to see my Ukifune!"

units.source_text: 浮舟听了两人交谈的话，但觉心胆俱裂。

en.t: Hearing the two women talk, Ukifune felt as though her heart and soul were being torn apart.

units.source_text: 她想：“我还是死了罢休。

en.t: She thought, "I had better simply die.

units.source_text: 不然，终于会流传丑闻。”

en.t: Otherwise, in the end, scandal will spread."

units.source_text: 此时宇治川中水势汹涌，其声凄厉可怕。

en.t: At that moment the waters of the Uji River were surging violently, and their sound was bleak and terrifying.

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人说：“别的河边水声并不如此可怕。

en.t: The Hitachi Governor's wife said, "The sound of water beside other rivers is not this frightening.

units.source_text: 这地方的荒僻实在是世间少有的。

en.t: The desolation of this place is truly rare in the world.

units.source_text: 所以薰大将舍不得叫浮舟长住在这里。”

en.t: That is why General Kaoru cannot bear to let Ukifune live here for long."

units.source_text: 她说时得意扬扬。

en.t: As she said this, she looked quite proud.

units.source_text: 于是大家谈论自古以来这河中所发生的可怕的事情。

en.t: Then everyone began talking about the frightening things that had happened in this river since ancient times.

units.source_text: 有一侍女说：“前些时，这里的渡船夫的孙子，是个小孩，划船时一不小心，掉在河里淹死了！

en.t: One serving woman said, "Not long ago, the grandson of the ferryman here, just a child, was careless while rowing, fell into the river, and drowned!

units.source_text: 这条河里淹死的人向来很多。”

en.t: Many people have always drowned in this river."

units.source_text: 浮舟想道：“我身倘也投入河中，不知去向，则大家大失所望，但这失望不过是暂时之事。

en.t: Ukifune thought, "If I too threw myself into the river and vanished without a trace, everyone would be deeply disappointed, but that disappointment would only be temporary.

units.source_text: 不然，我倘活在世间，则势必闹出怪事，惹人耻笑，而忧患永无绝期了。”

en.t: Otherwise, if I go on living in this world, I am bound to cause some strange affair, become a laughingstock, and my troubles will never end."

units.source_text: 如此想来，只要一死，则障碍全部消除，万事圆满解决。

en.t: Thinking this way, she felt that if only she died, every obstacle would disappear and everything would be resolved perfectly.

units.source_text: 然而回头一想，又觉非常悲伤。

en.t: Yet when she thought again, she felt terribly sad.

units.source_text: 她躺着听母亲诉说种种替她操心的话，但觉心乱如麻。

en.t: She lay there listening to her mother say all sorts of worried things on her behalf, and felt her heart tangled in confusion.

units.source_text: 母亲看见她精神萎靡，身体消瘦，非常担心，对乳母说：“你去找个地方，替她举办祈祷。

en.t: Seeing that she was listless and growing thin, her mother became very worried and said to the nurse, "Go find a place and arrange prayers for her.

units.source_text: 还得祭祀神佛，举行祓禊。”

en.t: We must also make offerings to the gods and buddhas and perform rites of purification."

units.source_text: 她们不知道她正在企图“祓禊洗手川”，徒然地在那里喧嚣忙碌。

en.t: They did not know that she herself was planning a "purification at the Handwashing River," and they bustled and made noise there in vain.

units.source_text: 母亲又吩咐乳母：“侍女太少了。

en.t: Her mother also instructed the nurse, "There are too few serving women.

units.source_text: 还须找寻适当的人。

en.t: You must find suitable people.

units.source_text: 新来的不可带进京中去。

en.t: Newcomers must not be taken into the capital.

units.source_text: 凡身份高贵的妇人，虽然本人气度宽大，但万一有了争宠之事，两方侍女往往发生纠纷。

en.t: With high-ranking ladies, even if the lady herself is generous, should there be any rivalry for favor, the serving women on both sides often fall into disputes.

units.source_text: 所以你要仔细选择，在这点上特别留心。”

en.t: So you must choose carefully and pay special attention to this point."

units.source_text: 她无微不至地叮嘱了一番之后，又说：“那边的产妇不知怎么样了，我也很担心。”

en.t: After giving instructions with the greatest care, she added, "I wonder how the woman in childbirth over there is doing; I am worried about her too."

units.source_text: 意思是即日就要回去。

en.t: She meant that she intended to go back that very day.

units.source_text: 浮舟忧伤之极，意气消沉，想到今后竟不能再见母亲了，说道：“女儿心绪恶劣，离开母亲便觉孤苦无依，让我暂时跟母亲回去几天吧。”

en.t: Ukifune was overcome with sorrow and sank into despair; thinking that she might never see her mother again, she said, "My spirits are dreadful, and when I am away from you I feel lonely and helpless. Please let me go back with you for a few days."

units.source_text: 她依依不舍。

en.t: She could not bear to part.

units.source_text: 母亲说道：“我也这样想。

en.t: Her mother said, "I feel the same way.

units.source_text: 可是那边也嘈杂得很。

en.t: But things over there are terribly noisy too.

units.source_text: 你的侍女们到那边去，要做缝纫也不方便，地方狭窄得很。

en.t: If your serving women go there, it will be inconvenient even for sewing, and the place is very cramped.

units.source_text: 怕什么呢！

en.t: What is there to fear!

units.source_text: 即使你迁居到了辽远的‘武生国府’，我也会悄悄地前来看望你的。

en.t: Even if you move as far away as Takefu Provincial Office, I will come quietly to visit you.

units.source_text: 我身份低微，害得你处处受委屈，实甚可怜。”

en.t: Because my rank is low, you have had to suffer humiliation everywhere; it is truly pitiful."

units.source_text: 说着流下泪来。

en.t: As she said this, tears began to fall.
